subject: Task 6: spec revised, 7 blocking findings applied
body: Verified all 13 review findings against their cited sources and applied the 7 blocking ones (R1.1-R1.7) to specs/orca-worker-contract-spec.md: a new --report-dir with a refusal when missing, the worker_status field with a mapping from existing status values, coordinator-chosen directories per attempt, a required Skill call checked in step 5, AC-C1 excluding WORKER-CONTRACT.md, AC-1.1 exempting load, and a parse rule for --unattended. The 6 minor findings (R1.8-R1.13) are rejected for this cycle because the reviser brief forbids editing text no blocking finding names; R1.12 now also covers the new step-5 Skill check, and R1.9 notes that origin/master already has a WORKER-CONTRACT.md. fixcheck --dry-run exits 0 (57763 to 62054 bytes, 16 hunks all mapped); the coordinator's binding fixcheck step and review 2 remain.
